fields.atTau: finite number; exact source point tau at refresh
fields.solverTime: finite source solver epoch at refresh; held/imported history may precede exported solver epoch
fields.state: own-pocket | incident-support | released, from those two booleans
fields.incidents: array of current adjacent increasing-X same-front raw support records; held points have none

incidentFields.otherId: nonnegative integer stable source point identity
incidentFields.front: nonnegative integer current source component identity
incidentFields.boundSeconds: finite positive conservative provider retirement bound, seconds
incidentFields.minimumPacketAge: finite min(endpoint source tau, endpoint Float32 tau); CAN BE NEGATIVE for unformed younger neighbor
incidentFields.maxScale: finite positive actual bracket scale bound; includes H/caseA single/clamped case
incidentFields.maxAuthoredTD: finite positive maximum authored nondimensional touchdown within crossed case/clamp domain

sharedPredicate: own = jetPace !== undefined && jetUntil !== undefined && tau < jetUntil; geometric = own || (history.policy === bounded-C-incident-support/v1 && history.atTau === tau && history.geometricPaceActive && jetPace !== undefined && jetBase !== undefined)

packet.carrierPresent: shared geometric predicate => Float32 jetPace; otherwise NaN
packet.carrierAbsent: exact old own-pocket conditional => Float32 jetPace; otherwise NaN

pointPlacement: while shared geometric predicate holds, z = jetBase + jetPace * tau; fitted tau may advance by more than DT

refreshOrder.meaning: refresh active supports and isolated held history before crest matching/coast
tracker then fitted monotone clock advance then crash
refresh after original own-pocket watchdog, before geometric component watchdog and pace placement
refresh after all new throws are assigned once, before final geometry/air/water processing

publicExport: read-only deep copy of point/history/incident records; no refresh, clock advance, solver readback, or native actor relocation added
identityProof: Exact ordered point IDs, columns, fixed X, current unique front/join bracket, immutable jet fingerprint remain required. History is dynamic qualification only. Do not equate source and F32 ages or assert DT-age equality.
physicalOwnLifetime: jetUntil, physical live array, jetStrip funding/void/crash/pour/air expiry and original own-pocket watchdog unchanged; support history never extends own pocket
watchdog: If a raw contiguous front still has retained support, every own pocket is expired, and solver time-latestSourceTime >=2*max incident provider bound, remove whole dependent raw component before drawing; latest source epoch=max(jetAt ?? broke). Existing 2-lifetime watchdog factor is reused; not a normal global lease.
